meta.title: Careful What You Wish For
meta.description: One pelican envies the bicycle. The rider knows the bicycle never lets go.

script.line: Careful what you wish for. I've been trying to stop since Tuesday.
I do. Every time I sleep, I wake up on a newer bike.
I don't know. But this one has fewer brakes.

pelican-bike.name: Pelican on a Bicycle
pelican-bike.description: A road-weary pelican trapped on an endless succession of bicycles
